**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

The agreement contains no most-favoured-nation obligation. Section 3 prices the engagement solely by reference to each Statement of Work on a time-and-materials basis, plus expense reimbursement and taxes — there is no provision requiring Clear Capital to extend to RadialSpark terms no less favourable than those given to any third party, and no obligation to match third-party offers. This sits at the **preferred** position (no MFN burden on the customer), so nothing is flagged.

Two observations recorded in the rationale rather than raised as deviations:

- There is also no Vendor-granted MFN in our favour. That would have been welcome, but this rule does not require one, so its absence is not a finding.
- Section 3(b) lets the Contractor "change rates with 30 days notice to Company." That is a unilateral price-increase concern and belongs to the price-change rule, not to MFN — I deliberately did not flag it here to avoid double-counting the same commercial term.
